summary: Frontend-only smoke of Phase 3.5 ProductionLibraryWorkspace at /app/estimating. 10 of 13 review_request items verified end-to-end in the browser. 3 items (Detail Panel tabs, Company Brain insights, Add to Estimate footer) exist in code but are not UI-exercisable in this environment because Supabase production_items/knowledge_domains/service_categories/production_assemblies tables still return 404 (blocker documented in iteration_10/11) so no items can be selected to open the DetailPanel. Login inbox@twofungis.ca / TradeOS2024! works and redirects to /app/command-center. /app/estimating renders <ProductionLibraryWorkspace> with data-testid='production-library-workspace'. Header shows 'Production Library' + subtitle 'Company Knowledge Engine'. Left Navigation is now RENDERED (fixed since iteration_11) with all 5 nav items visible: Company Standards, Knowledge Domains, Assemblies, Service Categories, Templates (data-testids nav-standards / nav-domains / nav-assemblies / nav-categories / nav-templates). Clicking each nav item swaps the main content area to a dedicated view: DomainsView shows 'Knowledge Domains' header + descriptive empty state, AssembliesView shows 'Production Assemblies' + 'Create First Assembly' purple CTA, CategoriesView shows 'Service Categories' + description, TemplatesView shows 'Estimate Templates' + 'Coming in Estimate Builder' disabled pill. Cmd+K AND Ctrl+K both open the CommandPalette (data-testid='command-palette') showing all three Quick Actions: Create Company Standard (N), Create Assembly (A), Import Knowledge (I). Arrow-down keyboard navigation moves the highlight through actions (verified visually - Import Knowledge highlighted after 2x ArrowDown). Escape closes the palette. All new features from Phase 3.5 that are exercisable without seeded data are working.

integration_issues.issue: Four Promise.all GETs (/api/production-library/items, /domains, /service-categories, /assemblies) return 404 because Supabase tables are missing. fetchData swallows errors with only console.error - still no user-facing toast/banner. UX indistinguishable from 'no data'. This was previously flagged in iteration_11 and is still not addressed.

test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_production_library_import.py (from iteration_10, still valid - backend not tested this iteration)
action_items: BLOCKER (still open from iteration_10): Apply Supabase migrations for measurement_units, knowledge_domains, service_categories, production_items, production_assemblies. Without these tables, the DetailPanel (tabs Overview/Pricing/Productivity/Usage/History), Company Brain mock insights, and 'Add to Estimate' footer button cannot be UI-exercised - they exist in code but never render because selectedItem stays null.
MEDIUM: In fetchData(), when any of the four fetches returns >=500 or 404, surface a toast.error or an inline banner so users know the backend is broken. Currently silent and misleading.

LOW: DomainsView empty state hint 'Initialize your Production Library to create default domains' has no clickable action - the sentence dead-ends. Consider making 'Initialize your Production Library' a button that triggers the domain seed endpoint (or link to Import Knowledge).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx: Since iteration_11, LeftNavigation is now correctly rendered (L2006-2013), CommandPalette has keyboard navigation with ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape (L389-416), and view switching via renderViewContent() dispatches to DomainsView/AssembliesView/CategoriesView/TemplatesView (L1962-2001). Previous iteration_11 review comments addressed.

ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx L1345-1755 DetailPanel: cannot be UI-tested because no items exist in the DB. Code inspection confirms tabs array at L1348-1352 (overview/pricing/productivity/usage/history), Company Brain section at L1482-1486, and 'Add to Estimate' footer button at L1744 all exist as specified. Once Supabase tables exist and at least one production_item is seeded, clicking a row/card sets selectedItem and DetailPanel will render.

ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx handleImport still navigates to /app/production-library?tab=import but the workspace does not consume useSearchParams to render an <ImportWizard/>. Same dead-end reported in iteration_11 - Import Knowledge button click updates URL but no visible change. (Not in the current review_request scope but still a lingering bug.)

ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx L1798+ - `assemblies` state is loaded but no fetchData retry / error banner if the 4 parallel GETs fail. All 404s are silently swallowed - user just sees the empty state.

File is 2081 lines - approaching size limits. Consider splitting per view (CompanyStandardsView, DomainsView, AssembliesView, CategoriesView, TemplatesView, DetailPanel, CommandPalette, LeftNavigation) into separate files under /pages/app/production-library/ to keep this file <700 lines per <code_review_gudielines>.

success_rate.frontend: 10/13 review_request items PASS end-to-end. 3/13 items (Detail Panel tabs, Company Brain insights, Add to Estimate) verified via code inspection only - cannot be UI-exercised until Supabase Production Library tables are created and at least one item is seeded (blocker from iteration_10).

seed_data_creation: None created - Supabase Production Library tables still return 404 so no rows can be inserted through the app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 5 dedicated views (CompanyStandards / Domains / Assemblies / Categories / Templates) are wired and rendering empty states correctly. Once Supabase migrations are applied AND at least one production_item is seeded, retest these unexercised paths: (1) click a production-item row/card -> DetailPanel opens with 5 tabs (data-testids not yet found for tabs - check code around L1345 to add tab-overview/tab-pricing/tab-productivity/tab-usage/tab-history testids if missing), (2) verify Company Brain insights section renders inside the Overview tab with the mock observations (mockObservations at L138-146), (3) verify 'Add to Estimate' footer button renders and click handler fires (handleAddToEstimate), (4) verify DomainsView renders actual domain cards (data-testid='domain-card-{id}') instead of empty state, (5) verify CategoriesView renders category-card-{id}, (6) verify AssembliesView renders assembly-card-{id} when assemblies exist. Data-testids present and verified this iteration: production-library-workspace, left-navigation, nav-standards, nav-domains, nav-assemblies, nav-categories, nav-templates, open-command-palette, command-palette, command-palette-input, import-knowledge-btn, new-standard-btn, expand-nav-btn, collapse-nav-btn.
rca of the issue: No frontend regressions. All Phase 3.5 rewrites work as specified. The only outstanding blocker for full validation is unchanged: Supabase Production Library schema (production_items, knowledge_domains, service_categories, production_assemblies, measurement_units) still returns 404 from the backend API, so DetailPanel/Company Brain/Add to Estimate cannot be exercised in the browser. Fix requires main agent to apply the pending Supabase migrations, then seed at least one row per table for end-to-end testing.
